notes.title: Ricochet staying free for a month!
notes.notes:
Ricochet will stay free for at least a month. Anyone can still download the game for free and will still be able to for a while. I apologize for the mishap, its my bad. I hope this isn't an inconvenience to anyone. I hope that more people are happy with the ability to download for free.

Ricochet is planned, but not guaranteed, to become paid on February 17th.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41548251/1374521ede9a2da58ecc29918b6d4cd2b6227b31.png[/img]

notes.title: Ricochet is going paid!
notes.notes:
Now that Ricochet has been out for a short time, I will be changing the games pricing from free to play to 5 US dollars. 

Ricochet will be changing pricing on Monday January 18, 2022.

I want to thank everyone that downloaded Ricochet for free, and I appreciate you all trying the game.

Anyone that currently owns Ricochet for free will keep it, and not have to pay anything extra, so download it fast before it becomes paid!

notes.title: Ricochet Level Editor!
notes.notes:
This update features a new Level editor in ricochet!
1. build and save your custom levels
2. load in other peoples levels

User levels scene
1. play levels in your custom levels folder

Grappling!
1. press the left trigger to grapple
2. you can grapple for 2 seconds
3. you have 3 grapples
4. you cant grapple if you use all your grapples, not if your grapple time runs out

Minor bug fixes/improvements
1. added recoil when you shoot
2. added a hook pickup to recharge your grapples

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.notes:
Achievements are now available through steam!

The main menu has been reworked into an interactive museum.

In the museum, press the X button on your controller to interact with doors.

The title screen is now just for clarity.

notes.title: Streak Shot Update!
notes.notes: New weapon, the streak shot. For each successful hit, your multiplier increases. If you shoot a bullet that bounces without hitting the opponent, your streak is reset.
